---
title: "07. Downloaded DEM metadata inspection"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{07. Downloaded DEM metadata inspection}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

The download module exposes recorded source files to a child metadata inspector.
Choosing a file under **View downloaded DEM** starts its preview automatically.
**Recheck file integrity** explicitly repeats checksum verification. Cold viewing
hashes the source once. Metadata and bounded preview results are reused from a
session-owned disk cache when the receipt, file size/timestamps, sidecars and
software version match. Size/time indicators do not establish cryptographic
integrity; changed or missing files invalidate reuse. Session close stops the
worker before removing its viewing cache.

Version 9031 adds rectangular detail selection. Drag a brush on the current image
and choose **Inspect selected area**. `dem_brush_window` maps displayed coordinates
to integer source pixel offsets, reverses the plot's upward y-axis into top-row
order, and expands fractional boundaries outward. Nested views retain their
absolute source offsets. Brushes entirely outside the image are rejected.

Each result gets a new brush ID (`view_id`), so old browser selections cannot
retarget a later result. The detail action captures its window before clearing
the current result, then uses the same context-bound cancellable worker. The
backend validates that the complete window lies inside the source. **Preview
elevations** requests NULL window and resets to the full tile. Results explicitly
distinguish sampled versus native data and report 1-based source row/column ranges.
Native data means no source-cell downsampling; the screen can still scale the
image. The colour scale is recalculated per view. Neither action saves terrain.

In version 9030, **Preview elevations** uses the same cancellable worker lifecycle
to call `fluvgeo::preview_stream_dem_download`. It returns a plain numeric matrix,
not a live raster pointer across processes. `draw_dem_preview` plots the source
pixel grid with a colour scale; grey marks sampled missing/non-finite cells.
The maximum display is 512 rows/columns. GDAL nearest-neighbour sampling uses
base-resolution pixels, applies band scale/offset and samples the embedded mask.
External sidecars/overviews are ignored. Temporary display rasters are confined
to the worker's temporary directory and removed on normal return; original assets
and receipts are unchanged. No reprojection or hillshade is performed.

This whole-tile overview can miss small features and NoData holes. It is not a
valid-data footprint, ground-resolution test, north-up map or suitability decision.
The source's column/row orientation is retained, including rotated grids. Constant
and all-missing samples remain displayable. The inspector clears previews on the
same context/file changes as metadata. Numerical generation and drawing are tested
with asymmetric grids, scaled data, missing values and constant/all-missing grids.

| Boundary | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `stream_dem_download_server` to `inspection_context` | Current attempt, scope and eligible receipt file IDs; null during transfers or verification |
| `stream_dem_inspection_server` to `launch_stream_dem_inspection_job` | Explicit file selection, separate callr process, isolated library paths |
| Worker to `fluvgeo::inspect_stream_dem_download` | Validate immutable selection/receipt association and contained asset; verify checksum |
| Backend to `inspect_terrain_vertical_reference` | One cold checksum read; ordinary and embedded compound CRS observations plus grid metadata |
| Result to UI | Escaped text tables and WKT; session-only observations, no writes or acceptance |

The controller captures context and file ID. A changed context clears the result
and stops/joins the worker; polling rejects results for a changed file even if
termination is delayed. Cancel and session close stop the worker. Healthy local
work has no elapsed-time cutoff. Errors remain
visible instead of being converted to unknown metadata.

Grid spacing is the length of each affine column/row vector in source CRS units.
It does not automatically evaluate the 1 m ground-resolution criterion. Missing
vertical declarations remain unknown; exposed declarations do not establish the
reference actually used to produce elevations. Metadata reads do not qualify all
pixels, valid coverage, hydro-flattening or scientific suitability. Visual review
at native resolution and durable acceptance remain subsequent work.

Source: `R/stream_dem_inspection.R`, `R/stream_dem_download.R`; tests:
`tests/testthat/test-stream-dem-inspection.R`. Backend contract:
`fluvgeo/dev/schemas/stream-dem-inspection.md`; backend tests:
`test_stream_dem_download.R` and `test_inspect_terrain_vertical_reference.R`.
